title: XCG 33 corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: XCG 33 corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: XCG 33 corn is a white hybrid corn variety. About 97 days to harvest, 6.1 t/ha in trials. See its pest ratings and traits.
excerpt: XCG 33 corn is a white hybrid corn variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1984. Pioneer Overseas bred it. It takes about 97 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 6.09 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

**Yield:** 6.09 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

XCG 33 corn takes about 97 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is 4.1 days faster than the average of the 25 white hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 101.1 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 6.09 t/ha matches the average of its group, 6.21. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It was weak against corn borer, so scout for it from the early weeks. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant XCG 33 corn

Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 97 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 6.09 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of XCG 33?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
